name: Lucy Whitehead
bio: is a fourth-year TAPS and English Major. She is so excited for everyone to see the amazing work everyone has put into this wonderful production; and eternally grateful to the Sanctuary City cast and crew for putting their hearts and souls into her vision! Directing credits include The Council (Definition Theatre), Red Rex (University Theater), The Tempest (University Theater). Assistant directing credits include How We Got On (Definition Theater, Directing Apprentice), Untitled Vampire Play (Lookingglass Theatre), Keerah (Definition Theater, Directing Apprentice), and Arcadia (The University of Chicago). As her last show, she’d like to thank everyone for making her time in University Theater the highlight of her college experience. She’s grateful to Newark, New Jersey for making Sanctuary City possible, but she’s doesn’t really understand its whole deal.

name: Remi Chin
bio: is a third-year MADD and Bizcon double major. With UT, they have previously been on If/Then (ASM), The Tempest (Asst. Sound and Asst. Scenic), Antigone (Stage Manager), and Red Rex (Co-sound). Outside of UT they have also worked on shows with UBallet, Konnex Dance Collective, the SLIPAR Showcase, and LVV circus. They really enjoyed seeing Sanctuary City come together and have enormous respect for everyone who was part of this story-telling process. They think Newark has a silly shape, like one of those inflatable dancing tube advertisement thingies, but short.

name: Quentin Mills
bio: is a fourth-year Biology major. He has previously worked on Arsenic and Old Lace (Assistant Production Manager) and Red Rex (Assistant Sound Designer). His other artistic pursuits include Ankara Magic and UChicago Praisebreak. His opinion on New Jersey is that it’s a little less new but it’ll never get old.

name: Jasmine Li
bio: is a fourth-year Anthropology and Linguistics major. She has previously worked on Julius Caesar (Stage Manager), Red Rex (Assistant Stage Manager), As Y’all Like It (Stage Manager), Cactus Flower (Assistant Stage Manager), Troilus and Cressida (Assistant Stage Manager), Strings Attached (Assistant Production Manager), and Taming of the Shrew (Assistant Stage Manager). She is incredibly grateful to be working on this production with this wonderful company, and hopes you enjoy the show! She has passed through Newark, New Jersey a handful of times in her life, but admittedly only when extremely sleep-deprived, so she doesn't remember much about it.

name: Elisa Gao
bio: is a fourth year Astrophysics and TAPS major. Her previous scenic design credits with UT includes This is As Good As It Gets, Red Rex, The Tempest, Troilus and Cressida (Asst.), and Royal Flush. She also designed costumes for Swan Lake (Ballet), Pericles, Giselle (Ballet), As Y’all Like It, Coppélia (Ballet), 35MM: A Musical Exhibition, Sylvia (Ballet), Royal Flush, and Falsettos (Asst.). She was acting in the TAPS pro show Happy Birthday Mars Rover and dancing in On the Back of Before. Her thought on Newark is that she mailed her comforter from LA to her sister who currently lives in Newark and is looking forward to reunite with her comforter when she visits her sister in a month.

name: Shanthal Ramos Bueno
bio: is a fourth-year student studying Sociology & RDI! She has previously worked on If/then (Assistant Costume Designer), Cactus Flower (Co-Costume Designer), Our Town (Lead Costume Designer), and Red Rex (Lead Costume Designer). She is so grateful to be a part of such a wonderful and hardworking group of people!! Shanthal lived on jersey city remixes all throughout middle school, so shoutout jersey!! and dubsmash!! :)

name: Seth Wang
bio: is a fourth year Anthropology and Gender Studies major with a Visual Arts minor. He has previously worked on As Y’all Like It (Co-Director), Troilus and Cressida (Props), Red Rex (Co-Props), Julius Caesar (Props), The Play That Goes Wrong (Asst. Props), Arcadia (Asst. Props), and Much Ado About Nothing (Asst. Scenic). He finds the state of New Jersey to be confusing and inexplicable.

name: Ryan Witter
bio: is a fourth-year (eek!) Linguistics, Anthropology, Gender Studies, and Middle Eastern Studies major. His previous roles include Arsenic and Old Lace (Mortimer Brewster), Red Rex (Greg), As Y’all Like it (Co-Director), Troilus and Cressida (Director), Arcadia (Asst. Props), The Play That Goes Wrong (Props Designer), Richard III (Clarence/York/Derby), and The Taming of the Shrew (Vincentio/Curtis). He’s also President of the Dean’s Men and will be directing Measure for Measure next quarter (please come!). He’s grateful to Lucy for putting so much into this show, and to the whole cast and company for being lovely, incredible people. Having spent last summer in Philadelphia, he’s legally obligated to say: Go Eagles and Fuck Jersey!

name: Chenoah D.
bio: is a 4th year Linguistics major. She worked on her first show, Red Rex (Assistant Lighting Designer), earlier this year. Her opinion on Newark is that its pronounced /Nork/ not /New-ork/.

name: Cami Delgado
bio: is a fourth-year Astrophysics and Visual Arts major. They previous credits include Julius Caesar (Scenic Designer), Red Rex (Lighting Designer), As Y’all Like It (Assistant Director/Dramaturg), Troilus and Cressida (Lighting Designer), Much Ado About Nothing (Lighting Designer), The Play That Goes Wrong (Assistant Stage Manager), Richard III (Lighting Designer), and Taming of the Shrew (Assistant Lighting Designer). Despite having lived in New Jersey for a few years, they often forget that Newark, New Jersey exists.

name: Anna Cho
bio: is a second-year Linguistics/TAPS major. She has previously worked on Dream Delivery Service (Asst. Sound), Pericles (Asst. Director), The 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee (Asst. Sound), and Our Town (Sound). She would like to thank Hannah and both the Lucys for all of their help! She invites everybody to guess how many cues are in the sound montage. She loves New Jersey, is from New Jersey, and wishes she was back in New Jersey every day.

name: Lilianne Asokwah
bio: is a third-year Sociology and Law, Letters, and Society major. In UT, she worked on The 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee (Assistant Director)! She has previously been a part of Thoroughly Modern Millie (Ensemble) and Little Women (Ensemble). The only thing she’s heard about Newark comes from her mother, who lived there after immigrating to the U.S. For context, she hated it. We haven’t been since.

name: Ulyana Sharapova
bio: is a first-year Astrophysics major. This is her first show with UT and she hopes that there will be many more to come! Newark is such a cool place for the show to be set in, and it really is a shame that Martyna Majok made it all up because she would have loved to visit it one day.

name: Kate Guerrero
bio: is a first-year English Literature student, beginning her University Theater journey with Sanctuary City. Her previous theater experience primarily includes four years of wrangling middle school students as assistant director, stage manager, hairstylist, personal cheerleader, and facilitator of ice breakers. She’d like to thank the Sanctuary City cast and crew for making her feel at home with UT! Another of her thank you’s goes to Newark, New Jersey, a magical place that possesses the ability to fulfill her lifelong dream of climbing up a fire escape.

name: Charlie Carden
bio: is a second-year TAPS major (and maybe creative writing and history minor). This is his fifth UT show. They worked on Our Town (Assistant Stage Manager), The Burden of Burial (Scenic and Props Designer), Pericles (Assistant Stage Manager), and This is as good as it gets (Assistant Stage Manager). Outside of UT, his theater experience includes Mamma Mia (Stage Manager), Our Place (Stage Manager), Legally Blonde (Assistant Stage Manager), Keepers at the Edge of the Sea (Director), and The Legend of Sleepy Hollow (Stage Manager). His opinion on Newark, New Jersey is that it should have been a really big ark if they were gonna name it “new ark”.

name: Lucy Thomson
bio: is a first-year Biology major. This is her first show with University Theater, and she is so excited to be part of such an amazing group of people! The only thing she knows about Newark is that it has an airport... Maybe one day she'll be lucky enough to have a layover there.

name: Daniel Erani
bio: is a third-year biology major whose previous UT credits include The 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee (Leaf Coneybear), The Arsonists (Gordon Biedermann) and The Tempest (Caliban). As a PROUD New Jersian, he is enamoured with all the beauty that New Jersey (including Newark) has to offer, so he is able to forgive Newark for having possibly the ugliest bridge in New Jersey, the Pulaski Skyway. Jersey Girls UP!
